profileText:
Headline: Backend Engineer | Building resilient APIs and data services

About: Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building reliable services for SaaS products. I focus on API design, operational clarity, and thoughtful collaboration with product teams.

Experience:
Senior Backend Engineer, AtlasPay (2022-present)
- Designed Node.js and TypeScript services handling payment workflows.
- Migrated synchronous jobs to a queue-based architecture, reducing p95 processing time by 38%.
- Introduced service-level dashboards and on-call runbooks for a team of 7 engineers.
- Partnered with security to implement OAuth 2.0 and token rotation.

Backend Engineer, Cartwise (2020-2022)
- Built REST and GraphQL APIs with Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Improved slow database queries and added integration test coverage.

Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, REST, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, OAuth 2.0, observability, Jest
jobDescription: Build highly available backend services, design APIs, improve database performance, and partner on secure distributed systems. TypeScript, PostgreSQL, cloud infrastructure, and observability experience are useful.
